name: Ambuja Cements Limited
summary: Ambuja Cements Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, markets, and sells cement and related products to individual home builders, developers, institutional clients, masons, contractors, architects, and construction professionals in India. The company operates through Cement and Ready Mix Concrete segments.
